regions.finding: Room-temperature 30 min reaction and ESI sampling produced ion 5; the subsequent 85 °C observation and CapExit comparison are retained as method context.
Two distinct 85 °C nitrogen-atmosphere mixtures, respectively without and with imine but without K2CO3; ions 5 and 7 were observed. They are kept as separate records.
Full five-component reaction sampled at 5 min, 20 min, 40 min, 5 h, 15 h, 24 h and 36 h. Each sampling stage is a distinct partial record because the detected/disappearing ions differ.

Analytical sample-preparation comparison: CH3CN gave the best but still short-lived ion-8 signal; 25, 50, 200 and 400 µL dilution volumes gave no better signal than 100 µL. Logged as method context rather than synthetic reaction rows because variant-specific ion outcomes are not given.

Reactants 1–3 were separately tested under standard sample preparation and under K2CO3-saturated CH3CN; standard tests were negative, modified tests detected ions 9 from 1 and 10 from 3, while 2 remained undetected.
SORI-CAD results for ions 5–7 and the opening of the MS/MS/MS result for 5A; linked to the four fragmentation records whose spectra appear on page 4.

regions.finding: Proposed catalytic mechanism: ligand dissociation, oxidative addition to 5, carbopalladation to 7, deprotonation/imine addition to 8, and intramolecular allylic amination to 4 with Pd(PPh3)2 regeneration. All arrows are represented as separate steps within one mechanism record.

Accurate experimental/theoretical masses and relative errors for ions 5, 5A–5C, 6, 7, 7A, and 8–12. This is characterization evidence for existing time-course/fragmentation species, not twelve new reaction experiments.
